native_cache_history.qualification: Actual checkpoint BF16 W1/W2 on one 910C with fixed synthetic predecessors/base. Full-hit graph uses immutable precomputed M4 rows and keeps BF16 add/argmax. Partial-hit graphs receive preclassified hit/miss lanes and use compact M1–M3 native W2 plus reassembly. No miss classifier timing, cache mutation, HCCL, model replay or workload hit-rate claim. Four current Python source SHAs match; no fresh native execution, loaded-binary attestation or universal N-shard/shape proof. Do not repeat unchanged allhit/mixed fixtures; workload allhit rate and paid classifier/cache mutation remain missing.

request_scope: Hold every prior target/draft iteration and every request start fixed. Advance only the first token publication for the current carrier. Each substitution ends at the measured first native Fill after the fifth score transition. The wide interval starts even before the selected target head. Rank-local, TP join and cross-16 clock bounds retained separately.
request_limits: The Fill is a device suffix marker. It is not the Python bookkeeping call, a client send or a completed D2H event. CPU submission intervals, later device or network release, other streams, changes to earlier iterations and overlap with the next target are not priced here.

The installed code and the separate EP0 metadata establish host ordering for the witnessed path, not wall-time alignment of that execution to joint168 or proof that every device task delayed a particular client output. The async wait is conditional on that source path and stream assignment.
limits: Only old EP0/EP8 mirrored C8 B4,K5,R256,V129280 windows for local sums; not full16rank/request or sixordinary timing. Native W2 scalar/source identities are a separate historical fixture.
Whole spans include necessary base/W2 math, copying and exposed gaps; gaps are not proved host-only or free. New math/collectives/cache misses/classifier/format costs must be paid.
Fixed target vocab gather/layout summary and terminal tiny recipes are historical stopped children, not a cap on full base-head/Markov/verification parent.

Current-carrier request envelopes freeze every earlier iteration/start and end at the next measured Fill, not CPU/D2H/client completion; do not sum them with local fractions or claim actual request speedup.
